nodes.name: application-dev.properties
nodes.summary: Development Spring Boot profile configuration enabling SQL logging, Flyway migration repair options, Redis caching, upload storage defaults, and local fallbacks for payment and JWT secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring profile properties override the shared application settings for local and Docker development behavior.

nodes.name: application-prod.properties
nodes.summary: Production Spring Boot profile configuration that validates the database schema, disables automatic SQL initialization, and defaults authentication cookies to secure mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Production settings intentionally avoid schema mutation and rely on validated migrations.

nodes.name: application.properties
nodes.summary: Shared Spring Boot application configuration covering active profiles, PostgreSQL datasource access, JWT and OAuth2 authentication, upload paths, Redis, Actuator health probes, and login rate limiting.
nodes.languageNotes: The file uses environment-variable placeholders extensively so deployment-specific secrets and infrastructure endpoints can be injected at runtime.
